camel_example: aliyun vod AttachAppPolicyToIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyNames VODAppFullAccess --IdentityType RamRole --AppId 'app-0000' --IdentityName 0000
description_en: Grants a RAM user or RAM role permissions to access ApsaraVideo VOD applications
description_zh: 调用本接口为指定身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）附加点播应用的访问权限
kebab_example: aliyun vod attach-app-policy-to-identity --identity-type RamRole --identity-name 0000 --app-id app-0000 --policy-names VODAppFullAccess --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachAppPolicyToIdentity

parameters.description_zh:

- **RamRole**：RAM角色。

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the RAM user or the name of the RAM role.

- Specifies the RAM user ID when the IdentityType parameter is set to RamUser.
- Specifies the name of the RAM role when the IdentityType parameter is set to RamRole.
parameters.description_zh:

- 类型为RamRole时，传入角色名称。

parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en:
Only system policies are supported. Separate multiple policy names with commas (,). Valid values:

- **VODAppFullAccess**: permissions to manage all resources in an application.
- **VODAppReadOnlyAccess**: permissions to read all resources in an application.
- **VODAppAdministratorAccess**: application administrator permissions.
parameters.description_zh:
策略名称。多个名称使用英文逗号（,）分隔，暂时只支持设置为系统策略，可选值：
- **VODAppFullAccess**：管理和操作应用下所有资源的权限。
- **VODAppReadOnlyAccess**：只读访问应用下所有资源的权限。
- **VODAppAdministratorAccess**：应用管理员权限。
